choices.why: This compact black-brown desk is shallow enough at 50 cm for the narrow room and gives the gaming corner a dark, sober base with storage.
The all-black swivel chair has a masculine gamer look that matches the dark desk.
The black leather sofa is modern and masculine, and its straight shape suits the narrow room better than the chaise longue.
This 120 cm black TV bench fits the right wall without taking up too much space and pairs with the desk and sofa.
The black-brown glass table looks light in the narrow space and repeats the desk's finish.
The dark shelf with metal brackets has an industrial gamer look, and its 79 cm width suits the desk below it.
No candidate is RGB, but this slim black LED gooseneck lamp has the most modern, techy look.
The black rug with white stripes adds bold, masculine contrast against the light wood floor.
The heavy velvet is the closest to blocking out light, and its turquoise adds a bright gamer accent.
The black-and-white urban photos fill the large wall over the sofa with a modern, masculine style.
Two red velvet cushions add an eye-catching gamer-style accent against the black leather.
The ZZ plant is tall, hardy and low-maintenance, and it adds green near the balcony.

answer.why: A black base of leather, black-brown wood and metal gives the room a modern, masculine character, while the red and turquoise accents bring the eye-catching gamer colors the user asked for against the white walls and light wood floor.
